description: This file defines the Toolbar class for the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, managing toolbar behavior, including initialization, scroll handling, container changes, and button states.

classes.name: Toolbar
classes.description: Class managing the toolbar functionalities in Summernote editor.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Toolbar with context and binds methods.

methods.name: shouldInitialize
methods.description: Determines if the toolbar should initialize based on options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the toolbar, binds events, and prepares UI.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up toolbar elements and event bindings.

methods.name: followScroll
methods.description: Handles the toolbar's position during window scroll and resize events.

methods.name: changeContainer
methods.description: Changes the toolbar container based on fullscreen state.

methods.name: updateFullscreen
methods.description: Updates the toolbar UI for fullscreen mode.

methods.name: updateCodeview
methods.description: Updates toolbar buttons for codeview mode.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates toolbar buttons, optionally including codeview.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates toolbar buttons, optionally including codeview.
